findings.evidence: `exp_zsmul_smul_mem` at Exp.lean:101 already has the natural signature `{S : Type*} [SetLike S V] [AddSubgroupClass S V] {M : S}`, while `expZSMulAddAut` at line 178 narrows it to `(M : AddSubgroup V)`; LatticeAction.lean:101 must consequently pass `(kostantOrbit e h v).toAddSubgroup`.
findings.fix: Use `{S : Type*} [SetLike S V] [AddSubgroupClass S V] (M : S)` throughout the generic construction and characterization, and give the Kostant wrapper the same generalized carrier signature.
findings.issue: `expZSMulAddAut` and its private helper/characterization require `M : AddSubgroup V`, excluding other subgroup-like objects such as submodules from receiving an action on their own subtype; the same restriction propagates to `expZSMulKostantAddAut` at line 64.

summary: The new restriction API is unnecessarily specialized to `AddSubgroup`, despite the immediately preceding preservation theorem supporting every `AddSubgroupClass`.
